_comment: Executable field mapping for the Vendor > Products & Services module.
Every field name here was taken from the frontend source of truth in
form-state interfaces and the validate() blocks in the identity pages.
`required` mirrors the exact fields the frontend blocks Save & Continue on.
This file drives server-side validation (CategoryFieldRegistry) and is served

raw-commodity.title: Raw Commodity
raw-commodity.description: Unprocessed natural materials, grains, seeds, or bulk agricultural raw inputs.

processed-commodity.description: Primary processed materials, refined oils, starches, derivatives, or milled flours.

blend._note: No dedicated form in the UI — selecting this card falls through to the base '1.2 Product Identity' block, so this card uses identity.baseFields. Leave `fields` empty to keep that behaviour.
